# GovInfo

> GovInfo is the Federal Government's official repository for legislative, executive, and judicial publications, providing public access to Congressional documents, Federal Register, Code of Federal Regulations, and other government information.

GovInfo, operated by the Government Publishing Office (GPO), succeeded FDsys as the primary platform for digital dissemination and preservation of U.S. government publications. The platform serves as a trusted digital repository certified under ISO 16363 standards, ensuring long-term preservation of official government documents for public access.

## Key Topics

- GovInfo Platform
- Government Publishing Office (GPO)
- Congressional Documents
- Federal Register
- Code of Federal Regulations
- Digital Preservation
- Public Access
- FDLP (Federal Depository Library Program)

- RSS Feeds

- Government Publications
- ISO 16363 Certification

## Getting Started

- [About Us](https://govinfo.gov/about): Overview of GovInfo, GPO, FDLP, and transition from FDsys with FAQs.
- [Browse by A to Z](https://govinfo.gov/browse-a-z): Alphabetical directory for browsing GovInfo's government publications and congressional documents.
- [U.S. Government Information](https://govinfo.gov/about/us-gov-info): Overview of legislative, executive, and judicial branches of U.S. Federal Government.

## Developer Resources

- [Developer Hub](https://govinfo.gov/developers): Developer hub for accessing GovInfo API, bulk data, GitHub repositories, and RSS feeds.
- [System Design and Documentation](https://govinfo.gov/developers/system-design): GovInfo System Design Document (SDD) for technical architecture and platform reference.
- [RSS Feeds](https://govinfo.gov/feeds): RSS feeds for GovInfo collections with 100 most recent documents published.
- [Sitemaps](https://govinfo.gov/sitemaps): XML sitemaps for crawling and harvesting GovInfo document collections.

## Content Management

- [Agency Submission](https://govinfo.gov/about/agency-submission): Guide for Federal agencies to submit content to GovInfo for preservation and public access.
- [Digital Preservation](https://govinfo.gov/about/digital-preservation): GovInfo digital preservation practices, ISO 16363 certification, and trustworthy repository standards.
- [Authentication](https://govinfo.gov/about/authentication): Guide to PDF document authentication and digital signature verification in GovInfo.

## Optional Resources

- [Policies](https://govinfo.gov/about/policies): GovInfo policies covering digital dissemination, preservation, copyright, and accessibility.
- [History](https://govinfo.gov/about/history): Timeline of GovInfo evolution from GPO Access through FDsys to current platform.
